notes.title: Budgeting is growing among UK adults
notes.text: In 2026, 41% of adults said they keep a monthly budget, up from 36% in 2025, according to a national survey of money habits. The rise is steady rather than sudden, and it comes alongside wider use of round-ups and savings pots in budgeting apps. Savers who budget are more likely to use round-ups, which suggests that tools which make saving automatic are now part of how people manage their money rather than an extra. For a budgeting app, this points to messages about steady habits and small automatic steps, rather than one-off big changes in January.

notes.title: January is the peak for budgeting interest
notes.text: January is the month when interest in budgeting peaks, so a return message lands best in the first weeks of the year.
